label: prepare-static-log-snapshot
command:
git fetch origin main && python3 - <<"PY"
import pathlib,subprocess,json
entries=[]
for p in sorted(pathlib.Path("logs").glob("*")):
    path=str(p); sha=subprocess.check_output(["git","hash-object",path],text=True).strip()
    old=subprocess.run(["git","rev-parse","origin/main:"+path],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if old.returncode==0 and old.stdout.strip()==sha:continue
    entries.append({"path":path,"mode":"100644","type":"blob","content":p.read_text()})
pathlib.Path("/tmp/static-log-upload.json").write_text(json.dumps(entries,ensure_ascii=False));print(len(entries))
PY
action: 检查仓库最新提交并准备补传本轮原始审计日志。
outcome: 已获取最新 main，日志差异清单已生成；不重复提交已同步且未变化的源码。
next_step: 补传新增日志，继续等待云端镜像阶段。
